Name: Item Bags for All Cornucopia
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[size=4][b][i][u]现在，关于菜谱的物品袋已经被添加到可选文件。

Now, the item bag about the recipe has been added to the optional file.[/u][/i][/b]

老实说，我之前就想把Cornucopia的三个mod放进同一套袋子里了。

[/size][size=4]原本的技术不允许，因为我无法保证每个人都安装了三个mod而不是选择其中一部分。现在更新的item bag 的beta测试版使三合一得以实现。

[/size][size=4]原先的众多袋子被集合成了4个，分别是种子包，花包，作物包和工匠包。全部由皮埃尔出售。原先的三个袋子的mod我会将它们隐藏，因为随着Cornucopia更新，它们实际上已经有所缺失了。

[/size][size=4]虽然在只安装Cornucopia - More Crops的情况下，它也能正常运行并且自动匹配物品，但是我还是建议安装全部三个mod，因为它们三个的内容实际上有着很强的联系，单独安装可能会让游戏体验下降。另一方面，如果只安装Cornucopia - More Crops不安装其他两个，花包和工匠包里可能只少量物品，这让它们变得很无用。

[/size][size=4]关于工匠包，有一点需要注意，并非所有Cornucopia的工匠制品都可以放进袋子里，比如干花。这是因为不同的花产生的干花的价格是不同的，把它们放进袋子里会产生bug，类似的物品大约有10种，这些物品把我手动从袋子里移除了。

[/size][size=5][b][i][u]警告！请一定要使用item bag的最新beta版，不要安装原版。否则你会得到一个完全空白的袋子，因为它们的所有功能都是基于beta版实现的。
[/u][/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]To be honest, I had wanted to put the three Mods of Cornucopia in the same bag before.

[/size][size=4]The original technology doesn't allow it because I can't guarantee that everyone has installed three mods instead of choosing some of them. The updated beta version of item bag now makes the three-in-one possible.

[/size][size=4]The original bags were grouped into four: seed bag, flower bag, crop bag and artisan bag. All were sold by Pierre.I will hide the mod of the original three bags because with the update of Cornucopia, they have actually been missing.
[/size]
Although it can still run normally and automatically match items when only Cornucopia - More Crops are installed, I still recommend installing all three mods because the contents of the three of them are actually highly related. Installing them separately may reduce the gaming experience.On the other hand, if you install only Cornucopia - More Crops and not the other two, the flower bag and artisan bag may have only a few items in them, making them useless.[size=4]
Regarding the artisan bag, one point to note is that not all Cornucopia artisan products can be put in the bag, such as dried flowers. This is because the prices of dried flowers produced by different flowers are different. Putting them in the bag will cause bugs. There are about ten similar items, and I manually removed these items from the bag.

[/size][size=5][b][i][u]Warning! Please be sure to use the latest beta version of item bag and do not install the original version. Otherwise, you will get a completely blank bag, because all their functions are implemented based on the beta version.

[/u][/i][/b][/size][b][i][u]


[/u][/i][/b]
